Interface IuConstraintViolation

All Known Implementing Classes:
Violation
public interface IuConstraintViolation
One constraint failure: a value, where it was found, and which rule it failed.

  • Method Details

    • path

      String path()
      Gets the rendered path from the validated root object to the invalid value, for example details[2].strm or byCode[ABCD]<key>.

      Always names at least one property: every constraint this module evaluates is declared on a property, so nothing fails at the root object itself. See IuValidationNodeKind for the rendering rule of each segment.

      Returns:
      dotted and bracketed property path; never null, never empty

    • nodes

      Iterable<? extends IuValidationNode> nodes()
      Gets the same path as path() in structured form, root first.
      Returns:
      path nodes; never null, never empty

    • constraint

      Class<? extends Annotation> constraint()
      Gets the constraint annotation type the value failed, for example Pattern.
      Returns:
      constraint annotation type; never null

    • attributes

      Map<String,Object> attributes()
      Gets the declared attributes of the constraint annotation, for example regexp and flags for Pattern.

      Includes message, groups, and payload. These are the values a JSON Schema or OpenAPI generator needs in order to translate the constraint into a schema keyword.

      Returns:
      unmodifiable attribute map keyed by annotation method name; never null

    • messageTemplate

      String messageTemplate()
      Gets the uninterpolated message template, as declared by the constraint's message attribute.
      Returns:
      message template, for example {jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern.message}; never null

    • message

      String message()
      Gets the interpolated failure message, for example must match "\p{Alpha}{4}".
      Returns:
      human-readable message; never null

    • invalidValue

      Object invalidValue()
      Gets the value that failed the constraint.

      Excluded from describe() and from IuValidationResult.report() because validated input is frequently sensitive. Use IuValidationResult.report(boolean) to opt a rendered report into including values.

      Returns:
      invalid value; may be null, since NotNull is failed by a null value

    • rootType

      Class<?> rootType()
      Gets the type the validation pass started from.
      Returns:
      root type; never null

    • declaringType

      Class<?> declaringType()
      Gets the type that declared the failed constraint.

      Differs from rootType() when the constraint was inherited from a super-interface, or when the violation was found by cascading into a nested value.

      Returns:
      declaring type; never null

    • describe

      default String describe()
      Renders this violation as one line: path, constraint, message.

      Does not include invalidValue().

      Returns:
      single-line description
